about: The literal strings of the store's public code that the cart hand-off depends on (SPEC-storefront-watch.md § 3, F2). Each must be found, exactly and case-sensitively, in at least one JS file reachable from the order page's entry bundle. Each is quoted as the bundle has it, quotes and spaces included where they keep it exact (" CHECKOUT " is not found inside " CHECKOUT NOW "). Nothing else of the store's code is kept here.
read_from: the store's public bundle as served for /order?mpid=21 (the entry main-FEK5K7ML.js and the chunks it loads); the checkout's names (the hide list of SPEC-rung2-progress-and-checkout § 3, the checkout component and its pay button's container) from main-2HXLHIG7.js and the chunks it loads, the release the watch accepted on 2026-09-29

§ 25.3: Angular's own marker of an invalid form control (the framework's, in the store's forms code): Continue from step 2 does not advance while a displayed control of step 2 carries it, and focuses the first

§ 25.3: Angular's marker of a touched control: after a press of the store's pay button, a step-2 control ng-invalid AND ng-touched (the store's markAllAsTouched, or a refusal it receives) shows step 2

SPEC-snacks-in-the-cart § 3.2, § 3.3 (measured by § 1a): a snack's card is ready when it shows the store's Select Options, button.product__toggle (outside .product__actions), and a snack's first unit presses it once before the expansion's Add to Cart; read in the live release's files (main-UMGPHR2R.js, chunk-JYNIGECA.js) on 2026-10-08

SPEC-snacks-in-the-cart § 3.3: the block presses a snack's Select Options only while its aria-expanded is not "true", so it never closes an expansion (the store binds it to isAddonsExpanded(); main-UMGPHR2R.js, chunk-IWW3GX6Q.js, 2026-10-08)
